Name: Cuter RSV Forage and Crops Retexture
Author: StarDust0001
Description:
this is a simple visual redesign I made for my personal use.
It currently contains all of RSV Forage, crops and an object (Spirital Essence).
To use it, drag my file into Mods file, then replace it.
Though it only contains new images so it shouldn't have any problems, make sure to backup your files in case anything happens.

To do list:
Flowers
More objects

It was designed to use with HRyul's Farm_Forage Retexture on Naves
https://m.cafe.naver.com/ca-fe/web/cafes/28468938/articles/232604
It can work without it. You still need RSV for the obvious reason.
*You need to sign up an account first if you want to visit Navers.*
